steps.name: Epilogue ~ Adventurer in Iris
steps.objective: Take a look at the stories of those who visited [Iris] in the “Frozen World.”

lines.text: (In a space filled with ice, two beings have been fighting for a long time, but there is no sign of it ending.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When are you going to give up?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I'll keep doing this until you disappear!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It can't be helped. I'll deal with you until then.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Okay. then… . Wait, this power... .

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Why are spirits flocking here? That's Harmonia and Geass. Why are they here?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What's going on, Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Iris You don't have to fight here anymore.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's exactly what Gias said, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Is something like the Spirit King interfering with my fight to take over the body of a god?
(Evil Order moves forward, irritated by the appearance of the disruptor.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I can't move my body... ?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You, the being who disturbed this world and created it by tormenting Iris, disappear now.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What are you? Now, wait… . you are… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Harmonia, Geass.
(At the gesture of Harmonia and Geass, the spirits fly in and capture the Evil Order.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Kyaak, what are you going to do on a day when a lowly spirit king is nothing more than an alter ego of his master? That's funny.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A true master doesn't do that.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The master who causes discord in the world is not the master.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Iris, don't be scared. A girl who followed Ceres' fate and was reborn as a god. Now you work for your Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia… .
(Gaia nods.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I am a being who will swallow this world and become a god. Don't go against me. You have to keep dealing with me. So if you kill me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You and I are also the hearts of Iris. I also know that within this, it will never disappear.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: That's right, you know it well. Sigh… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: People have many minds. So does Iris. Among them, you want your bad feelings, mixed with fear, to continue to grow.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Iris is slowly finding stability. With the influence of everyone who wants other hearts to grow bigger than yours.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What do you want to say?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't realize it. The fact that I was with everyone right now... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … Please sleep now. This is for everyone... .

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What? If you have powers, there's no way I wouldn't know about it... .
(Iris extends its hand towards Evil Order, who cannot move. After a while, the spirits begin to cover Evil Order's body and face.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I can't leave like this! I will become the god of this world... . Become a god... .
(Time passes, and the spirits surrounding Evil Order disperse. Only the frozen image of Evil Order remains in front of them.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We'll go now.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then let's go out.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. Harmonia, Geass.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But where is Gaia? Gaia! Gaia!

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Iris… . Iris… .]

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia, where are you?

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [It doesn’t matter where I am right now. Iris, I have a favor to ask. Please continue to work with Adventurer. So that he can become Adventurer of Iris, not me or anyone else... .]
(Gaia's voice disappears and tears form in Iris's eyes. And a vivid and beautiful rainbow appears in the sky of the frozen world.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia… .
